definition: UPS units that bridge short interruptions (minutes) for equipment. Does not include batteries sized for hours of autonomy (battery backup) or generators.

Batteries charged from the main supply that keep a site running for hours during an outage. Includes batteries charged by solar where the sentence states a reserve during outages (hours or days of autonomy). Does not include short-bridge UPS units.
Diesel, gas or other fuel generators that start when the main supply fails. Does not include a second grid connection (independent power feed) or solar systems.
A second, independent connection to the electricity grid or a separate substation feed. Does not include generators, batteries or solar systems.

Solar or other renewable generation, with storage, installed so a site keeps running when the main supply fails. Does not include renewable systems that are the site's normal supply (that is renewable energy, not backup power).
Provides backup electricity for a specified duration
